fala: Davi não venceu Golias porque era corajoso.
cena: Seen from behind, a tiny young shepherd boy with a sling and staff stands on a rocky slope at the bottom of the sheet, facing an immense armoured Philistine giant whose bronze helmet, scale armour and huge spear rise far above him and are cropped by the top edge. Extreme scale contrast. Stormy Prussian-blue bokashi sky.

fala: Quarenta dias. Um exército inteiro olhando pro mesmo gigante.
cena: The Valley of Elah seen from high above: two steep hills facing each other, each crowded with tiny tents, banners and rows of spears of two armies; between them a winding brook in banded blues; alone in the valley floor stands the armoured giant, small at this distance, shouting; long mist bands of unprinted paper across the hills; dusk sky.

fala: Ele não mediu o gigante. Ele mediu Deus.
cena: A small young shepherd on a hilltop at night looks up at a vast sky that fills most of the sheet: deep Prussian-blue bokashi, countless stars, and broad rays of pale light breaking through layered clouds; far below, the enemy camp and the giant are tiny. Awe, the sky is infinitely larger than the giant.

fala: O seu gigante também tem nome.
cena: A lone small figure in a simple cloak stands at the foot of a colossal closed wooden city gate with iron studs, under heavy rain drawn as two sets of fine straight lines and a dark sumi bokashi storm sky; a huge looming shadow of a giant falls across the gate. Loneliness and pressure.

fala: Davi não tinha armadura. Tinha cinco pedras.
cena: Close crop: a young shepherd kneels at a clear brook and lifts a smooth round stone from banded blue water; four more smooth stones rest in his leather shepherd's bag; on the bank behind him a heavy bronze armour and helmet lie abandoned. Foam and ripples left as paper.

The armoured giant topples forward like a falling tree across the sheet in a strong diagonal, his spear flying loose, a cloud of dust rising as flat rounded bands; on the left the small young shepherd, sling still swinging after the throw; a single red sun disc in the sky.

fala: Para de medir o gigante. Mede quem luta por você.
cena: Peaceful dawn: the young shepherd with his flock of sheep on a gentle green hill, pines with flat-topped needle pads in the foreground, a red rising sun over layered mountains, long mist bands of paper, pale blue to peach bokashi sky. Calm and hope.
